shared_elements: repeated units arranged in a row/register
human faces or heads rendered in profile within some units
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic device of repeated units set in a line — a procession of standing bearded figures in A versus a border of square glyph blocks (a few containing profile heads) in B. A depicts a naturalistic narrative scene of figures carrying bowls and holding staffs, while B is a non-figural framed field of abstract sign-blocks around a large hatched disc, with no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
